name: Scale Arpeggiator Patterns
author: Freek van Gool
description: Arpeggiator presets for Scale Arpeggiator: classic patterns, trance and dance, house and disco, synthwave, ambient and cinematic, funk and jazz, fine grids (1/32, 1/64, triplets) and rolls, velocity and gate dynamics, generative and live playing. Velocity and length patterns give the accents, ghost notes and staccato or legato mixes.
